items.title: Return CRS tax-residency self-certification form
items.quote: Please complete the enclosed self-certification form and send it back to us by 29 October 2025.
items.computation: The bank is a private company, not a public authority, so there is no statutory deemed-delivery rule; it simply states a fixed calendar deadline. 29 October 2025 is printed verbatim and falls on a Wednesday (not a weekend or public holiday in NW), so no shift is needed. The form must reach the bank by this date.

warnings: This is a routine Common Reporting Standard (CRS) self-certification request, not a payment demand; the IBAN printed in the letterhead is the bank's own IBAN and is not something you are asked to pay to, so it poses no identified risk, but always verify any future payment instructions through a channel you already trust.

Consider verifying this request through a phone number or login you already have for Beispiel Direktbank AG (rather than the contact details on this letter) before sending personal tax-residency information, as CRS requests can be imitated in phishing attempts.
